append.detail: Rewards are pushed across devices. Migration 20270346002200 puts an AFTER INSERT trigger on zap_transactions and gem_transactions (every reward writer ends there) that sends a private Realtime Broadcast to member:<profile_id> (positive rows only, can never fail the write), and adds the Realtime authorization the row named: one SELECT policy on realtime.messages admitting a member to their own member topic, no publish policy. components/reward-live.tsx, mounted in the member layout, subscribes (Supabase client loaded lazily, nothing added to the shell eager chunk), raises the Zap or Gem toast unless this tab just showed it, and refreshes the page so balances move.
